description: This file defines the Popup_Picker class for handling popup selection dialogs for ACL Roles within the SuiteCRM environment. It manages generating HTML forms, processing search queries, and rendering list views for ACL Roles in the user interface.

classes.name: Popup_Picker
classes.description: Class to handle popup selection for ACL Roles in SuiteCRM, including rendering search forms and list views.

methods.name: _get_where_clause
methods.description: Generates the WHERE clause for search queries based on request parameters.

methods.name: process_page
methods.description: Processes and renders the popup page for selecting ACL Roles, including form setup, list view generation, and HTML output.
